---
title: Version 1.12
platform: Android, iPhone
target: December 2026
status: In progress
---

## What's planned

- Save items to read later, even when you're offline
- Dark mode that follows your device settings
- Faster start-up

## Android only

- Support for themed app icons

## iPhone only

- Home screen widget showing your saved items

## Details

Saved items are stored on your device. You can remove them at any time from
the Saved tab.
